proposed_widenings.name: resource-less triggered_reaction magic-item ability
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item triggered_reaction family inherits mandatory item resource and reset fields, but this item is an at-will reaction that only spends the wearer’s reaction quota.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier"

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage-reduction reaction is gated by having a free hand. Current equipment predicates cover holding/wearing/wielding states, but not an available empty hand.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The item’s main reaction fits an existing magic-item triggered-reaction shape only after widening that family to allow no extra resource/reset and widening the predicate surface for a free-hand gate. The catch-on-zero rider was left unmodeled because authoring stopped before placeholder encoding.
